task.title: Establish durable job leases and the scheduling entry
task.input: contract-types, the current permission foundation and the existing cron/mail switches
task.output: job-foundation, JobState, the fixed registry and POST /api/admin/cron/operations scheduling
task.accept: 1) Caller deploy/cron.nbshiyan leads to POST /api/admin/cron/operations; reject missing/incorrect Bearer credentials, use a fixed jobKey allowlist, and permit only one commit under concurrent lease+generation processing; batch must be at most 500 with a recoverable 55s deadline (E-81). 2) Register actual cron for the existing mail-queue wrapper under the original switches and Bearer requirements; after restart, actual scheduling must execute and leave JobState; dashboard GET must not trigger jobs; verify the schema-first diff plan without deleting old columns (E-64).
